scripts.title: Summarize CSV
scripts.description: Deterministic exploratory summary of a CSV: per-column type, missingness, and distribution statistics, written as CSV and Markdown.

args.name: --input
args.description: CSV file to summarize, path relative to the project root (/work)

scripts.inputs: One delimited text file with a header row.
scripts.outputs: summary.csv (one row per column) and summary.md (readable report) under $OUT_DIR.

scripts.title: GAMM smooth trends
scripts.description: Fit a generalized additive (mixed) model of an outcome over a continuous predictor with an optional random-intercept group; writes a full summary, tidy term tables, a population fitted curve with 95% CI, and a diagnostic plot.

args.name: --input
args.description: CSV file, path relative to the project root (/work)

args.name: --group
args.description: Grouping column fitted as a random intercept

scripts.inputs: Long-format CSV with one row per observation.
scripts.outputs: model_summary.txt, smooth_terms.csv, parametric_terms.csv, fitted_curve.csv, smooth_plot.png under $OUT_DIR.
